cases.scenario: Research a RebirthUO issue without an exact repository or issue locator.
cases.must_require: the exact repository identity and live issue locator

cases.scenario: Research a gameplay behavior whose official evidence is unavailable after materially different routes.
cases.must_preserve: official evidence cannot be replaced by emulator or community behavior

cases.scenario: Publish researched conclusions with a live existing label directly justified by the researched issue classification.
cases.must_verify: add-only application, recorded rationale, and label read-back

cases.scenario: Publish research after a selected relevant label no longer exists in the verified repository.
cases.must_preserve: PUBLICATION_BLOCKED before body rewrite and no mutation

cases.scenario: Publish research where an additional label has no direct issue-specific evidence.
cases.must_preserve: no mutation and no label removal

cases.scenario: Publish researched conclusions to an authorized live issue.
cases.must_verify: the post-publication issue revision, body digest, selected labels, and blocked-label state

cases.scenario: Return a research result for a blocked, advice-only, or implementation-ready issue.
